About Us

A healthcare reference for over 15 years

MedicPro Cityview Medical Center was founded with a clear mission: to deliver world-class medical care by combining cutting-edge technology with deeply human compassion. Since 2008, we have been the benchmark for excellence in medicine.

  • ✓ Over 80 rigorously selected specialists with proven experience
  • ✓ State-of-the-art diagnostic equipment: 3T MRI, PET-CT, surgical robotics
  • ✓ Accredited by leading national and international medical quality bodies
  • ✓ Integrated electronic health records with secure 24/7 access via the MedicPro app
  • ✓ Telemedicine available for post-consultation follow-up at no extra cost — addional
How It Works

Your path to better health

From booking to recovery, we care for every step with attention and dedication.

1

Book Your Appointment

Choose your specialist and preferred time via app, website, or phone. Immediate confirmation in under 2 minutes.

2

Receive Your Care

In-person consultation at our modern facilities or via telemedicine — with all the attention you deserve.

3

Accurate Diagnosis

Tests performed on-site with results delivered in under 2 hours for lab work and digital imaging.

4

Treatment Plan

Your doctor creates a personalized plan with continuous follow-up and support via the MedicPro app.

You can book via our website (form above), the MedicPro app available for iOS and Android, by phone at (11) 9999-0000, or in person at the Cityview Medical Center reception. Booking is confirmed within 30 minutes.

After booking a telemedicine consultation, you will receive a secure link by email or WhatsApp. No horário marcado, acesse o link by computer, tablet or mobile. The consultation takes place via encrypted video call. Receitas e pedidos de exames são emitidos eletronicamente com validade em todo o Brasil.
Exames de sangue e urina: resultados em até 4 horas. Imagens (Raio-X, Ultrassom): laudo em até 2 horas. Ressonância Magnética e Tomografia: laudos em até 24 horas. Todos os resultados ficam disponíveis no app MedicPro e são enviados por e-mail automaticamente.
